yt_title: Your table just learned to read ✨ #Shorts
yt_description:
Still tagging, sorting and summarising rows by hand? Add an AI field to any Stackby table and every row fills itself.

Write one prompt, like "classify each message as Billing, Bug, Feature or Praise, rate the sentiment and write a one-line summary", pick your model, and run it on every row. New rows fill in automatically.

What you can do with AI fields
• Classify: support tickets, leads, feedback, products
• Summarise: long messages, notes and descriptions
• Extract: names, companies, dates and amounts into clean fields
• Generate: product descriptions, replies, translations

👉 Try AI fields free: https://stackby.com/signup
